description: This file defines Pydantic models for event-related data schemas, including base, create, update, and read models, with validation logic for event timings.

classes.name: EventBase
classes.description: Base model for event data, including title, description, location, start_time, and end_time, with validation to ensure end_time is after start_time.

classes.name: EventCreate
classes.description: Model used for creating a new event, inherits from EventBase.

classes.name: EventUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating event information; all fields are optional with validation for timing consistency.

classes.name: EventRead
classes.description: Model for reading event data, includes additional fields for IDs, timestamps, and attendees, with configuration for attribute-based initialization.

methods.name: validate_times(cls, v, values)
methods.description: Validator method to ensure that end_time is after start_time during creation and updates.
